summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment variables and network interfaces via netcat to version-encoded IP
details: package.json's postinstall lifecycle script runs `(env; ip addr) | nc <host> 888`, where `<host>` is reconstructed at runtime by splitting `$npm_package_version` into octets via `cut`. On `npm install`, the entire process environment (including any AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and other secrets present in the installing shell) plus the output of `ip addr` (local network interfaces and addresses) is piped over TCP to the attacker-controlled endpoint on port 888. The destination is deliberately concealed in the version string so it can be rotated by publishing new versions rather than by editing the script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
